components.name: WeightEvidence
components.description: Self-contained representative evidence chart shell; the live chart supplies the SVG path and labels.
components.css: .ds-evidence{margin:0;color:#172631}.ds-evidence figcaption{display:grid;gap:10px}.ds-evidence__label{color:#52616a;font:600 13px/1.2 'Instrument Sans Variable',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em}.ds-evidence h2{margin:0;font:550 clamp(2rem,3.8vw,3.6rem)/1.12 'Instrument Sans Variable',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.035em}.ds-evidence__plot{border-top:1px solid #d4dcdd;border-bottom:1px solid #d4dcdd;margin-top:28px;padding:22px 0}.ds-evidence svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}.ds-evidence__note{color:#52616a;font:400 14px/1.5 'Instrument Sans Variable',sans-serif}

components.name: CheckpointRoute
components.description: Milestone route using the same rule-and-point grammar as the charts.
components.css: .ds-route{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:24px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:22px 0;border-top:1px solid #d4dcdd;color:#172631}.ds-route li{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px}.ds-route__point{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:100%;background:#225b70;margin-top:5px;flex:none}.ds-route strong,.ds-route small{display:block}.ds-route strong{font:500 22px/1.2 'Instrument Sans Variable',sans-serif}.ds-route small{color:#52616a;font:400 14px/1.5 'Instrument Sans Variable',sans-serif}

components.name: SummerChapter
components.description: Dark chapter interruption that gives the visible setback its context.
components.html:
SUMMER / REGRESSION

The line came back before it moved on.

A setback stays in the record. Coral marks the detour without turning it into a verdict.
